rows.title_full: AN ACT DECRIMINALIZING ADULTERY AND CONCUBINAGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLES 333 AND 334 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Reasons that this particular provisions of the Revised Penal Code which criminalize marital infidelity (that of having a sexual intercourse with other person other than his/her spouse) clearly discriminate against women spouses.

rows.author: H058;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE COCONUT FARMERS AND INDUSTRY TRUST FUND AND PROVIDING FOR ITS MANAGEMENT AND UTILIZATION
rows.title_short: Coconut Farmers And Industry Development Act
rows.abstract: Seeks to consolidate all coconut levy assets into a trust fund called Farmers and Industry Trust Fund; delineate the Trust Fund from the General Fund, hence preventing the marriage of the two; create the Coconut Farmers and Industry Trust Fund Committee under the Office of the President to be chaired by the Secretary of Agriculture with the primary task of monitoring the implementation of the Fund and the Coconut Industry Development Plan, which shall be use as a guide in the utilization of the trust income; empower the Privatization and Management Office as the sole entity to dispose of the coconut levy assets that have been approved for privatization, and; mandate the Presidential Commission on Good Government to conduct a complete accounting and inventory of all coconut levy assets and for the Commission on Audit to audit the inventory of coconut levy assets prepared by the PCGG.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05745

committee_action.action: Scheduled for meeting/hearing on 2016-10-18
committee_action.meethigh: A Technical Working Group was created to further study the proposed measure together with other Coco Levy Fund bills. The Committee agreed to use HB 6135, the Coconut Farmers and Industry Development Act, as approved in the 16th Congress, as reference bill.

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2016-11-10
committee_action.meethigh: The Technical Working Group meeting was attended by all sectors which includes small coconut farmers organizations, concerned government agencies and other industry stakeholders. A second TWG meeting was scheduled to continue the deliberation on the proposed measure.

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2016-12-08
committee_action.meethigh: A third TWG meeting was scheduled to continue deliberation of the proposed measure.

rows.abstract: Seeks to guarantee that the exploration, development and utilization of mineral resources will primarily benefit the Filipino people; prioritizes sustainable livelihood choices of communities; gives utmost importance to food security and livable conditions for the people; ensures that the gains from the mining industry would be maximized while preventing or mitigating its adverse effects; recognizes that the issue of environment and sustainable development is local and thus prioritizes local participation in decisions surrounding mining; ensures the protection and human rights of communities and individuals; and imposes harsh penalties for the violation of its provisions.

rows.author: G064;I099;
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE SECURITY OF TENURE OF WORKERS AND EMPLOYEES IN THE PRIVATE SECTOR AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to clearly define legitimate contractor or subcontractor as an employer engaged in providing job, work or services to another business; recognize industry peculiarities in the determination of functions and standards on contracting and subcontracting; criminalize labor-only contracting; grant license of contractor and subcontractors; require mandatory posting of bond to answer for the wages and other monetary benefits due the workers and employees in case the contractor fails to pay the same; require coverage of the cooperatives as employers in contracting or subcontracting; reiterate the right to security of tenure to the effect that all workers and employees in the private sector shall not be dismissed without cause and due process; define the criteria for the existence of an employee relationship; classify all employees as regular except those under probationary employment, or those under industry-specific work arrangement as may be determined by the Secretary of Labor and Employment through tripartite consultation; and provide for probationary employment which shall not exceed six (6) months.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06908
